title: 135 Months vs. 155 Months: The Two Theranos Verdicts

lines.say: One hundred thirty-five months for Elizabeth Holmes. One hundred fifty-five for Sunny Balwani. Same indictment. Same judge. Same sentencing range.
lines.show: 135 months for Elizabeth Holmes. 155 for Sunny Balwani. Same indictment. Same judge. Same sentencing range.
